subject: Problem using collapse with geom_cladelabel and geom_hilight

messages.author: abe6a47bc87582c6
messages.subject: Problem using collapse with geom_cladelabel and geom_hilight
parts:
Hi,

I'm using the github version 2.1.1 and have found that when trying to use geom_cladelabel on a tree where I have collapsed a node I get the following error:

Warning messages:
1: Computation failed in `stat_clad_bar()`:
subscript out of bounds 
2: Computation failed in `stat_clade_text()`:
subscript out of bounds

Furthermore, geom_hilight will only make a box around the node rather than the whole clade. Please see example below:


tr <- rtree(15)

#Cladelabel and hilight working as expected

gg <- ggtree(tr) +
      geom_tiplab(size=3,  fontface='italic') +
      geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node), hjust=-.3) +
      geom_hilight(23, fill="wheat2", alpha=0.3, extend=0.35) +
      geom_cladelabel(23, "clade", barsize=1, offset=0.36, offset.text=0.005, fontsize=3)
plot(gg)




#No cladelabel and warning returned, also strange highlight after collapsing

gg.col <- collapse(gg, node=25)
plot(gg.col)



I'm not sure if this is a bug or I'm missing something obvious. Thanks very much,

Rowena
